Title: Add per-tool 30s CancellationToken timeout with structured error response
Description: All LLM-backed tools should have a 30-second configurable hard timeout (separate from the connection-level timeout) that returns a structured error instead of hanging: { error: { code: TOOL_TIMEOUT, message: 'Tool timed out after 30s. Try smaller input or check node health.', retryable: true }, meta: {...} }. The 30s value should be configurable per tool in appsettings. This is independent of the NodeB fast-fail fix (TSK-0001/P0.1) — even when NodeB fast-fails in 5s, individual tool operations on Node A could still hang.
